g.text: FlareRank2Convo2 begins.
Check boolean FlareBackstory1
How do we... not... talk about what's going on?
true
false
How're you settling in?
true
What do you think about the rest of the protoframes so far?
true
How'd you wind up in this mess in the first place, anyway?
false
i don't know. i really don't... but if we do, it might... it might happen. so it's best not to
like a brick thrown through the ceiling of someone's greenhouse
what adorably lovely freaks, the lot of them
mess is an understatement, huh.
So just... "la la la it's not there?"
You really just want to pretend?
... Painfully?
Lol. What's that supposed to mean?
i could sit around and watch them all for days. which is good, seeing as that's all i have to do. hah
Update boolean FlareBackstory1
what else am i supposed to do?
i don't *want* to do it, but i don't know how else to go about it, traveler.
+5 Chemistry
i've shown up rather abruptly and made a right mess of somebody else's shit, haven't i?
i can't wait to work them all into my music
got the weirdest call one day, from some slithery little shitbird. preening his feathers and puffing himself up like he was trying to prove something
it's like its there in the corner of the room, just staring at me, constantly
hah, sorry. no, i meant - i feel like i'm crashing a party nobody invited me to
Look around. Höllvania was pretty messed up before you arrived.
The brick didn't ask to get chucked, now did it?
i wonder if i could teach them to play...
telling us all about how important he was, how this city was "failing" and "losing faith" and how we could "help him in his noble cause to set it straight"
eyeless, but always watching, lidless, hollow, *hungry*
mm, i suppose. hard to break what's already been broken
no, but it did make itself into a very useful-looking blunt object, now didn't it?
Check boolean QuincyArthur2
he really thought he had an idea of who he was talking to. best part? claimed he was a *fan*
waiting for me to blink. waiting for me to look, to glance over, or to let down my guard, and then it'll snap
still, can't help but feeling like i'm making things worse, not better
but i get your point
I've got it on good authority that Arthur can sing.
true
I know Aoi would join you in a *heartbeat.*
true
false
Oh, Void. I'm picturing them all in a band. I think I'm going to die laughing.
true
false
I...wish you the absolute best of luck with that.
false
nothing worse in this world than watching idiots misuse your words for their own goals
like a shark with blood in the water...
all because i let myself get used by entrati. i wanted the power to show that little shitbird that he couldn't kill the music
i got used. but i also let myself get used. i was angry. i wanted the power to show that little shitbird that the music wouldn't die
he doesn't seem like the backup singer kind of material, but who knows
what an adorable image
but it's all a pipe dream...
so, of course we said yes. mainly just because i knew we had to piss that little shitbird off and show him just how tiny his dick actually is
Whoa, calm down for a second. What're you talking about?
Okay, Flare. You're scaring me.
but... i'm... settling in, to answer your question
i'm a duet, now... soon to be a solo, if she gets her way...
wish i'd believed the tabloids about the whole weird plague thing, though
i'm sorry...
you aren't alone in that
even if i think if i never eat another pizza again in my life, i would die happy
Am I supposed to just keep ignoring this?
that was pretty effin' shit
i can't control it
have these monsters never heard of a goddamn *sandwich?!?!*
Ooof.
You caught techrot?
how it happens, when she -
*and* on top of that, she just keeps *pestering* me about feeding her constantly all these weird things like -
0/5 stars. would not visit again. as i'm lying there in the tour bus, there's a knock on the door
Is this like a... multiple personality thing?
DAMN IT
Entrati?
Let me guess.
if only it were that simple
ding ding ding.
psh you know how the story goes. magical mystery cure? promises me that i'll become a performer the likes of which the world has never seen?
no, space traveler... that's Lizzie...
etcetera, etcetera, etcetera.
she's my guitar...
that shitbird wanted a concert? well he got one all right. now, my stage character's always been a bit... much
and... she wants to consume what's left of my soul...
always been me with the volume cranked up as high as it could go
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank2Convo3.
but now? *now?* it was like i was running higher than the clouds, running on some kinda juice i didn't even know *existed*
Then what?
Void's a helluva drug.
standing on that stage, the new me, i felt... alive. truly alive. more me than i'd ever felt before. it was glorious. freeing. i felt like i was flying
what?
we gave Höllvania a concert they'd never forget. that shitbird wanted us to give them hope? and faith? we did. in themselves
Never mind, continue.
next thing we know they're flipping scaldra trucks and pulling over statues hahaha
that lil shitbird was so pissed...
should've known it would have costed us...
well... them...
I heard.
What happened...?
yeah.
shitbird decided he'd get his show. one way or another. only this time? it wouldn't be a concert
couldn't stop them. too many of them. vs just me? i see you chewing through them like candy...
it's the kind of show you only get to put on once...
me over here like a baby giraffe figuring out where its legs are supposed to be
couldn't do much except just... watch them die...
shitbird did it on national tv, too...
crowing about the ratings like it was something to be proud of...
i guess it makes perfect sense that she'd...
feed off of all that hate, all that grief, all that rage
like a shark, sensing blood in the water
i know she's "introduced" herself to you, now.
how it happens, or when she... appears
i'm sorry...
i can't control it
Is this like a... multiple personality thing?
if only it were that simple
no, space traveler... that's Lizzie...
she's my guitar...
and... she wants to consume what's left of my soul...
Chat ends. Next chat will be FlareRank2Convo3.
